auth_details: Local Client Portal Gateway uses browser login (username/password + 2FA) to establish a session; requests go to the local Gateway after authentication. Separate OAuth 2.0 applies to remote Client Portal Web API for third-party apps. Account required.
free_tier_limits: No standalone free API plan; access requires an eligible IBKR brokerage account (typically IBKR Pro). No separate API SaaS fee; market data and commissions billed per IBKR schedule.
paid_plans: No separate API SaaS fee; brokerage commissions + optional market data subscriptions apply. Access requires an opened IBKR account.
rate_limits: Client Portal Web API: ~10 requests/second global pacing; many endpoints have stricter limits (e.g. GET /portfolio/accounts often 1 req/5s). Exact limits vary by endpoint in IBKR docs.
resolution_notes: auth: auditor correct — localhost Gateway is browser/session auth, not OAuth bearer for this base_url (https://www.interactivebrokers.com/campus/ibkr-api-page/cpapi-v1/#authentication). pricing: auditor correct — free_tier=false; API has no SaaS fee but requires IBKR account, not a free public tier (same CPAPI docs + IBKR account requirements). rate_limits: auditor correct that concrete pacing is published — 10 req/s global and endpoint-specific (e.g. portfolio/accounts) per IBKR CPAPI docs (https://www.interactivebrokers.com/campus/ibkr-api-page/cpapi-v1/#rate-limiting / endpoint notes). example: auditor correct — self-signed cert needs --insecure; generic Cookie header unnecessary after Gateway browser auth (https://www.interactivebrokers.com/campus/ibkr-api-page/cpapi-v1/).
